entities.summary: French Revolution, a transformative movement in Saint Lucia (1789–1798). Emerged from British capture Saint Lucia 1762 — returned to France 1763 and American Revolution. Catalyzed Enslaved people and free coloreds seize power, abolish slavery 1795 and British reconquest after fierce Brigands' War 1796.
